open_issues: ThemeToggles persists the theme choice through the real FileUiStateStore (src/Wakeel.Desktop/Services/FileUiStateStore.cs) under %LocalAppData%\Wakeel\ui-state.json, since that file sits outside this package's allowed edit paths and so cannot be pointed at an isolated per-test location. Mitigated by resetting the theme to 'system' in a finally block and by W08ScreenshotDiff explicitly forcing light before its screenshot, but a developer's own desktop app could theoretically be left mid-test-run in dark mode if a run is killed between the theme click and the finally block.

W08ScreenshotDiff records a 34.10% pixel-diff (deterministic across two consecutive full runs) against 'design/exports/light/W/W08 — مركز الانتباه.png' — as specified, no pass/fail threshold is applied; the delta is layout/content drift (e.g. the four KPI cards render in reversed order vs. the mockup, differing sample row content) rather than a rendering bug — visually verified by inspecting both PNGs. Fixing W08's actual layout is out of this package's scope (later B-series work).
notes:
Two full 'dotnet build src/Wakeel.Desktop && dotnet build tests/Wakeel.E2E && dotnet test tests/Wakeel.E2E --no-build' runs were green (4/4 passed both times, ~14-17s each) and left no Wakeel.Desktop.exe process behind either time; the whole Wakeel.slnx solution also still builds clean (0 warnings/errors) after the MainWindow.xaml.cs change. Measured W08 diff: 34.1035% (identical both runs).

Key design decisions:
- --start-url uses BlazorWebView.StartPath (discovered via reflection over the installed Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.WebView.Wpf package) rather than any JS-injection hack — clean, and confirmed live: the CDP /json/list endpoint showed url "https://0.0.0.1/gallery" after launching with --start-url=/gallery. The fixture reads this origin back from the live page (new Uri(Page.Url)) instead of hardcoding the BlazorWebView virtual host scheme/host.
- --window-size sets the BlazorWebView control's own Width/Height plus Window.SizeToContent=WidthAndHeight (in code-behind only — MainWindow.xaml itself was left untouched since only App.xaml.cs/MainWindow.xaml.cs code-behind is an allowed edit path), so the WebView2/CDP viewport is exactly WxH regardless of window chrome (title bar/borders), independent of the default XAML Height=768/Width=1366 when the flag isn't passed.
- tests/Wakeel.E2E now targets net10.0-windows10.0.19041.0 with UseWindowsForms=true (no new NuGet package) purely to get System.Drawing.Common from the Microsoft.WindowsDesktop.App shared framework for System.Drawing.Bitmap-based PNG pixel compare in ImageDiff.cs — Directory.Packages.props has no image-diff library pinned, and adding one is disallowed by this package's rules.
- Microsoft.Playwright needs no `playwright install`/browser download for this suite: it only ever calls ConnectOverCDPAsync against the already-running WebView2, never launches a bundled browser. Documented as a fallback comment (and in build/e2e.ps1's header) in case a fresh machine's NuGet-cached driver is ever missing.
- LaunchedWakeelApp.StartAsync takes remoteDebuggingPort and pollPort as separate parameters so the exact same production launch/readiness/kill code path used by WakeelE2eFixture is reused by AppLaunchTimeoutTests (omitting --remote-debugging-port so CDP genuinely never opens, rather than faking the scenario) — proven by asserting the new WakeelAppLaunchException.ProcessWasKilled flag, not just that an exception was thrown.
- [assembly: CollectionBehavior(DisableTestParallelization = true)] keeps the whole assembly sequential: two concurrently-launched Wakeel.Desktop.exe instances would collide over the same fixed WebView2 profile folder (%LocalAppData%\Wakeel\WebView2), which src/Wakeel.Desktop/Services/WakeelPaths.cs (out of scope) doesn't parameterize per-instance.
- Manually verified end-to-end once outside the test run too (built the exe by hand, launched it with all three flags, curl'd /json/version and /json/list) before writing the harness, confirming the CDP endpoint, page URL and start route all behave as expected.
